03 · Agent handoff

Composition brief

Build page compositions for a case-management product. - Marketing hero: proposition, proof, one primary action. - Application home: orientation and next actions. - Case overview: identity, route, current stage, stakeholders, artifact, next decision. - Workspace: main work plane plus contextual inspector. - Decision review: evidence, alternatives, rationale, and equal Proceed / No-Go actions. - Portfolio: dense case list with meaningful states. - Final dossier: readable narrative record. - Mobile composition: reorder priorities rather than shrinking desktop. For every page, state what dominates, which actions persist, what moves on mobile, and what must not appear.
